posts.title: Mount Makiling Folklore and Encounters
posts.description: There are mountains you climb for the view, and then there is Mt. Makiling, where apparently, your hiking preparations should include not only water, snacks, and decent footwear, but also a brief assessment of your moral character and that of whoever you're bringing along.
